parts.sql: select "pos-payments-june"."tender" as "tender", count(*) as "timeout_count" from "pos-payments-june"  where ("pos-payments-june"."tender" = ?) and (substr(substr("pos-payments-june"."ts",1,10),1,10) = ?) and ("pos-payments-june"."till_status" in (?,?)) group by "pos-payments-june"."tender" limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From payment attempt records; keep rows where pos payments.tender = 'UPI' and day(pos payments.ts) = '2026-06-20' and pos payments.till_status in ['failed', 'failed: no response']; group by pos payments.tender; report tender = pos payments.tender, timeout_count = count of *.
